extracted.intended_audience: metadata engineers, repository managers, data librarians, and integrators using the OpenAIRE Graph
extracted.subtask_description: Specification of the ResearchProduct object in the OpenAIRE Graph data model (v11.0.0), listing fields, types, cardinalities, examples, and subtype-specific extensions for publications, data, software, and other research products.

rubrics_metrics.name: ResearchProduct object (scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research products are intended as digital objects, described by metadata, resulting from a scientific process. The ResearchProduct object describes the properties common to research products and is extended by sub-types (Publication, Data, Software, Other research product).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the conceptual scope: metadata records representing outputs of research (literature, data, software, other). Sub-types inherit all fields and extend them.

rubrics_metrics.name: id
rubrics_metrics.description: Main entity identifier, created according to the OpenAIRE entity identifier and PID mapping policy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "doi_dedup___::80f29c8c8ba18c46c88a285b7e739dc3". Must follow OpenAIRE entity identifier rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: type
rubrics_metrics.description: Type of the research product as declared in the dnet:result_typologies vocabulary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Possible values include: publication, data, software, other. Example: "publication".

rubrics_metrics.name: originalIds
rubrics_metrics.description: Identifiers of the record at the original sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Example list: ["oai:pubmedcentral.nih.gov:8024784", "S0048733321000305", "10.1016/j.respol.2021.104226"].

rubrics_metrics.name: mainTitle
rubrics_metrics.description: A name or title by which a research product is known (e.g., publication title or software name).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "The fall of the innovation empire and its possible rise through open science".

rubrics_metrics.name: subTitle
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanatory or alternative name by which a research product is known.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "An analysis of cases from 1980 - 2020".

rubrics_metrics.name: authors
rubrics_metrics.description: The main researchers involved in producing the data, or the authors of the publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Author. Cardinality: MANY. Author structure includes fullName, rank, name, surname, pid (with scheme and value), and provenance/trust metadata. Example: an author object with orcid pid and provenance 'Harvested' with trust score.

rubrics_metrics.name: bestAccessRight
rubrics_metrics.description: The most open access right associated to the manifestations of this research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: BestAccessRight. Cardinality: ONE. Example: {"code":"c_abf2","label":"OPEN","scheme":"http://vocabularies.coar-repositories.org/documentation/access_rights/"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: contributors
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions or persons responsible for collecting, managing, distributing, or contributing to the development of the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Examples include institution names and individual contributor names (e.g., "University of Zurich", "Wright, Aidan G C").

rubrics_metrics.name: countries
rubrics_metrics.description: Country associated with the research product: the country of the organisation that manages the repository or CRIS system from which the record was collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: ResultCountry. Cardinality: MANY. Use country code/label; provenance and trust may be provided (e.g., {"code":"CH","label":"Switzerland","provenance":{"provenance":"Inferred by OpenAIRE","trust":"0.85"}}). Note: author affiliation countries are in affiliation relations, not here.

rubrics_metrics.name: coverages
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage statements associated with the resource (e.g., spatial/temporal coverage).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. (Page lists field but provides no detailed example text.)

rubrics_metrics.name: dateOfCollection
rubrics_metrics.description: When OpenAIRE collected the record the last time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "2021-06-09T11:37:56.248Z".

rubrics_metrics.name: descriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: A brief description of the resource and the context in which the resource was created.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Examples: multiple descriptive strings about research motivation or summary. Use for abstracts/summaries harvested from sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: embargoEndDate
rubrics_metrics.description: Date when the embargo ends and this research product turns Open Access.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "2017-01-01".

rubrics_metrics.name: indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicators computed for this research product, including citation-based impact indicators and usage statistics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Indicator. Cardinality: ONE. Supported types include citationImpact (fields: influence, influenceClass, citationCount, citationClass, popularity, popularityClass, impulse, impulseClass) and usageCounts (fields: downloads, views). Example shows numeric values and categorical classes (C1/C2/C3).

rubrics_metrics.name: instances
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific materializations or versions of the research product (e.g., pre-print, post-print, published version).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Instance. Cardinality: MANY. Instance objects can include fields such as accessRight (code,label,openAccessRoute,scheme), alternateIdentifiers, articleProcessingCharge (amount,currency), license URL, pids, publicationDate, refereed status, hostedby (journal/conference info), collectedfrom (source), type (e.g., Article), and urls. Example includes accessRight with openAccessRoute 'gold' and APC amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: language
rubrics_metrics.description: Alpha-3/ISO 639-2 code of the language describing the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Language. Cardinality: ONE. Values controlled by dnet:languages vocabulary. Example: {"code":"eng","label":"English"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: lastUpdateTimeStamp
rubrics_metrics.description: Timestamp of last update of the record in OpenAIRE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Long. Cardinality: ONE. Example numeric epoch timestamp: 1652722279987.

rubrics_metrics.name: pids
rubrics_metrics.description: Persistent identifiers of the research product (PIDs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: ResultPid. Cardinality: MANY. Examples: objects with scheme and value (e.g., {"scheme":"pmc","value":"PMC8024784"}, {"scheme":"doi","value":"10.1016/j.respol.2021.104226"}). See OpenAIRE PID mapping policy for canonicalization.

rubrics_metrics.name: publicationDate
rubrics_metrics.description: Main date of the research product: typically the publication or issued date. Selected among available version dates based on completeness and frequency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Selection rules: prefer most frequent well-formatted date; if none, choose most recent complete date. Examples and tie-breaking behavior described (pre-print vs repository vs Crossref). Example value: "2021-03-18".

rubrics_metrics.name: publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of the entity that holds, archives, publishes, distributes, releases, issues, or produces the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "Elsevier, North-Holland Pub. Co".

rubrics_metrics.name: sources
rubrics_metrics.description: Related resources from which the described resource is derived (Dublin Core dc:source).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Examples: repository or aggregator names such as "Research Policy", "Crossref".

rubrics_metrics.name: formats
rubrics_metrics.description: File format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Examples: MIME types such as "application/pdf", "text/html".

rubrics_metrics.name: subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject, keyword, classification code, or key phrase describing the resource. OpenAIRE classifies according to Field of Science and SDG taxonomies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Subject. Cardinality: MANY. Subject objects include scheme and value and may include provenance/trust (e.g., inferred by OpenAIRE or harvested). Examples show schemes FOS, SDG, and keyword values like "Open science".

rubrics_metrics.name: isGreen
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether the scientific result was published following the green open access model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Boolean. Cardinality: ONE. True/false flag.

rubrics_metrics.name: openAccessColor
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates the specific open access model used for the publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Possible values include bronze, gold, hybrid.

rubrics_metrics.name: isInDiamondJournal
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicates whether or not the publication was published in a diamond journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Boolean. Cardinality: ONE. True/false flag.

rubrics_metrics.name: publiclyFunded
rubrics_metrics.description: Discloses whether the publication acknowledges grants from public sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. May contain funder acknowledgement information or structured flag.

rubrics_metrics.name: projects
rubrics_metrics.description: List of projects (grants) that (co-)funded the production of the research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Project. Cardinality: MANY. Project entries include id, code, acronym, title, funder (shortName,name,jurisdiction,fundingStream), provenance/trust, and validated metadata (validationDate, validatedByFunder). Example shows an H2020 project with validated flag true.

rubrics_metrics.name: organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Organizations involved as project partners or responsible for operating data sources (companies, research centers, institutions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Affiliation. Cardinality: MANY. Organization records include legalName, acronym, internal id, and pids (e.g., ROR). Data are collected from funder databases and registries like OpenDOAR, re3Data, CORDA.

rubrics_metrics.name: communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to relevant research infrastructures, initiatives, or communities collaborating with OpenAIRE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Context. Cardinality: MANY. Community entries include code, label, and provenance/trust. Example: {"code":"sdsn-gr","label":"SDSN - Greece","provenance":[{"provenance":"Inferred by OpenAIRE","trust":"0.9"}] }.

rubrics_metrics.name: collectedfrom
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about the sources from which the record has been collected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: CfHbKeyValue. Cardinality: MANY. Example entries: {"key":"openaire____::081b82f96300b6a6e3d282bad31cb6e2","value":"Crossref"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication.container
rubrics_metrics.description: Container information for publications: the conference or journal where the research product was presented or published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: Container. Cardinality: ONE (for Publication subtype). Container fields include edition, iss (issue), issnLinking, issnOnline, issnPrinted, name (journal name), sp (start page), ep (end page), vol (volume). Example: name: "Research Policy", vol: "50", sp: "12", ep: "22".

rubrics_metrics.name: Data.size
rubrics_metrics.description: Declared size of the research data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE (for Data subtype). Example: "10129818" (likely bytes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data.version
rubrics_metrics.description: The version of the research data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE (for Data subtype). Example: "v1.3".

rubrics_metrics.name: Data.geolocations
rubrics_metrics.description: List of geolocations associated with the research data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: GeoLocation. Cardinality: MANY. GeoLocation objects may include box (bounding coordinates), place (text), point (latitude longitude). Example: {"box":"18.569386 54.468973 18.066832 54.83707","place":"Tübingen, Baden-Württemberg, Southern Germany","point":"7.72486 50.1084"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Software.documentationUrls
rubrics_metrics.description: URLs to the software documentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY (for Software subtype). Examples: links to README or project docs (e.g., GitHub README).

rubrics_metrics.name: Software.codeRepositoryUrl
rubrics_metrics.description: URL to the repository with the source code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE (for Software subtype). Example: "https://github.com/openaire/iis".

rubrics_metrics.name: Software.programmingLanguage
rubrics_metrics.description: Programming language used by the software research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: ONE. Example: "Java".

rubrics_metrics.name: Other.contactPeople
rubrics_metrics.description: People responsible for providing further information regarding the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY (for Other research product subtype). Example: list of named contacts such as "Noémie Dominguez".

rubrics_metrics.name: Other.contactGroups
rubrics_metrics.description: Groups responsible for providing further information regarding the resource.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY (for Other subtype). Example: "Networked Multimedia Information Systems (NeMIS)".

rubrics_metrics.name: Other.tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about tools useful for interpretation and/or re-use of the research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type: String. Cardinality: MANY. Examples include helper tools, analysis scripts, or utilities referenced alongside the product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.accessRight (instance-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Access rights of a specific instance, including open access route and scheme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically nested in instances. Example: {"code":"c_abf2","label":"OPEN","openAccessRoute":"gold","scheme":"http://vocabularies.coar-repositories.org/documentation/access_rights/"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.alternateIdentifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternate identifiers for a specific instance (e.g., DOI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example entries like {"scheme":"doi","value":"10.1016/j.respol.2021.104226"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.articleProcessingCharge
rubrics_metrics.description: Article processing charge information for a given instance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; include amount and currency. Example: {"amount":"4063.93","currency":"EUR"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.license
rubrics_metrics.description: License URL associated with a specific instance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example: "http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0".

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.pids (instance-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Persistent identifiers specific to an instance (e.g., PMC id).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example: {"scheme":"pmc","value":"PMC8024784"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.publicationDate (instance-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication date of the specific instance/version.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example: "2021-01-01". Instance dates may differ from ResearchProduct publicationDate and are used in instance-level selection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.refereed
rubrics_metrics.description: Refereed status of the instance (peer review status).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example value: "UNKNOWN" (could be true/false/unknown).

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.hostedby
rubrics_metrics.description: Host publication (journal/conference) information for the instance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; includes keyed host references (key and human-readable value), e.g., journal name "New Phytologist" with internal key.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instance.collectedfrom
rubrics_metrics.description: Source from which a specific instance was collected (instance-level provenance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nested in instances; example: {"key":"openaire____::081b82f96300b6a6e3d282bad31cb6e2","value":"Crossref"}.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicator.citationImpact (detailed metrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Citation-based impact indicators computed for the research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of indicators field. Includes numeric measures (influence, citationCount, popularity, impulse) and categorical classes (influenceClass, citationClass, popularityClass, impulseClass). Example: influence=123, citationCount=456, popularity=234, impulse=987 with classes C1/C2/C3.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicator.usageCounts
rubrics_metrics.description: Usage statistics for the research product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part of indicators field. Includes counts such as downloads and views. Example: downloads=10, views=20.
